subject.descriptionZh: 概率基础、概率分布与渐近理论、随机过程，以及描述统计、统计推断、统计建模、贝叶斯统计和计算统计。
subject.descriptionJa: 確率基礎、確率分布と漸近理論、確率過程、記述統計、統計的推定と検定、統計モデリング、ベイズ統計、計算統計。
subject.descriptionEn: Probability basics, distributions and asymptotics, stochastic processes, descriptive statistics, inference, statistical modeling, Bayesian statistics, and computational statistics.

Probability-Statistics.Probability-Basic.subject: Probability-Statistics
Probability-Statistics.Probability-Basic.descriptionZh: 条件概率、Bayes 定理、期望与方差、联合分布、相关性、随机变量组合与经典概率问题。
Probability-Statistics.Probability-Basic.descriptionJa: 条件付き確率、ベイズの定理、期待値と分散、同時分布、相関、確率変数の組合せ、古典的確率問題。
Probability-Statistics.Probability-Basic.descriptionEn: Conditional probability, Bayes theorem, expectation and variance, joint distributions, dependence, combinations of random variables, and classical probability problems.

Probability-Statistics.Probability-Distr.subject: Probability-Statistics
Probability-Statistics.Probability-Distr.descriptionZh: 常见离散与连续分布、分布变换、生成函数、大数定律、中心极限定理与分布逼近。
Probability-Statistics.Probability-Distr.descriptionJa: 代表的な離散・連続分布、分布変換、母関数、大数の法則、中心極限定理、分布近似。
Probability-Statistics.Probability-Distr.descriptionEn: Common discrete and continuous distributions, distributional transforms, generating functions, laws of large numbers, central limit theorems, and distributional approximations.

Probability-Statistics.Stochastic-Proces.subject: Probability-Statistics
Probability-Statistics.Stochastic-Proces.descriptionZh: 马尔可夫链、随机游走、计数过程、等待时间、停止时间与其他带时间或状态结构的随机模型。
Probability-Statistics.Stochastic-Proces.descriptionJa: マルコフ連鎖、ランダムウォーク、計数過程、待ち時間、停止時刻など、時間または状態構造をもつ確率モデル。
Probability-Statistics.Stochastic-Proces.descriptionEn: Markov chains, random walks, counting processes, waiting times, stopping times, and other stochastic models with temporal or state structure.

Probability-Statistics.Descriptive-Stati.subject: Probability-Statistics
Probability-Statistics.Descriptive-Stati.descriptionZh: 测量尺度、集中趋势、分位数、样本统计量、标准误与抽样偏差。
Probability-Statistics.Descriptive-Stati.descriptionJa: 尺度水準、代表値、分位点、標本統計量、標準誤差、標本抽出バイアス。
Probability-Statistics.Descriptive-Stati.descriptionEn: Measurement scales, location summaries, quantiles, sample statistics, standard errors, and sampling bias.

Probability-Statistics.Estimation-and-Hy.subject: Probability-Statistics
Probability-Statistics.Estimation-and-Hy.labelJa: 推定と仮説検定
Probability-Statistics.Estimation-and-Hy.descriptionZh: 点估计与区间估计、最大似然、估计量性质、显著性检验、多重比较、统计功效与样本量。
Probability-Statistics.Estimation-and-Hy.descriptionJa: 点推定と区間推定、最尤法、推定量の性質、仮説検定、多重比較、検出力、標本サイズ。
Probability-Statistics.Estimation-and-Hy.descriptionEn: Point and interval estimation, maximum likelihood, estimator properties, significance testing, multiple comparisons, statistical power, and sample size.

Probability-Statistics.Statistical-Model.subject: Probability-Statistics
Probability-Statistics.Statistical-Model.labelJa: 統計モデリングと実験計画
Probability-Statistics.Statistical-Model.descriptionZh: 线性与多元模型、最小二乘、回归诊断、判别分析、方差分析与实验设计。
Probability-Statistics.Statistical-Model.descriptionJa: 線形・多変量モデル、最小二乗法、回帰診断、判別分析、分散分析、実験計画。
Probability-Statistics.Statistical-Model.descriptionEn: Linear and multivariate models, least squares, regression diagnostics, discriminant analysis, analysis of variance, and experimental design.

Probability-Statistics.Bayesian-Statisti.subject: Probability-Statistics
Probability-Statistics.Bayesian-Statisti.descriptionZh: 先验与后验、共轭模型、后验赔率、贝叶斯推断与模型选择。
Probability-Statistics.Bayesian-Statisti.descriptionJa: 事前分布と事後分布、共役モデル、事後オッズ、ベイズ推論、モデル選択。
Probability-Statistics.Bayesian-Statisti.descriptionEn: Priors and posteriors, conjugate models, posterior odds, Bayesian inference, and model selection.
